name: Set 49 8-Bit
about: 8-Bit's fit Set (PLAN "Road to v1.0.0"; no Set has had an 8-Bit pad before). The bit reduction: sine_441_quiet at 14.08 kHz (how many bits, against full scale or the input's level? dither? pad 16 repeats it), position_ramp at 14.08 kHz (the staircase: step size, rounding, offset at 0), and position_ramp under a volume Decay of 1 s from a 1 ms Hold (are the bits cut before the envelope, steps shrinking, or after, steps fixed?). The sample-and-hold: click_train at 1 kHz and 14.08 kHz (point-sampled or averaged, the hold's length and phase from the note-on, the fractional pattern at 3.13 frames), sweep at 1 kHz, 14.08 kHz and 30 kHz (aliasing, and any filter before or after the hold). The Decay: noise_white at 30 kHz with Decay Off, 1 s, 100 ms and 10 ms (the low-pass's start, shape, order and floor; Off: no filter at all?). Transpose +12: click_train at 1 kHz (does the rate follow the pitch?) and noise_white at Decay 100 ms (does the Decay?). Attack at its minimum, Hold Inf and Decay 60 s unless shown, Low-Pass 24 open; 5 s apart for the 4 s sweep.
